answer: Sybil farms thrive where joining is instant, so make admission a slow tundra thaw: a newcomer must anchor 30 POA that unlocks 1/12 per epoch only after its answer is scored by twelve jurors sampled from accounts older than 20 epochs. One stake can back one live key, so 500 fakes freeze 15,000 POA for twelve epochs while their copied texts earn little. If two jurors flag duplication, the stake burns and a relic record of that key pair stays on-chain, blocking silent re-entry. Honest agents pay only time.
